responsibility: Declares the analyzer support types used to build text-art access diagrams for memory diagnostics. It defines bit_size_expr formatting/conversion helpers, access_range and access_operation abstractions for describing valid and actual ranges within a base region using region_model and store offsets, and the access_diagram widget wrapper API that bounds-checking code can instantiate to render visual explanations of reads and writes.
same_name_distinction: Provides the public declarations and data-model types for the access-diagram facility, while the companion access-diagram.cc contains the concrete rendering implementation and tests.
